user.title: Connect ESP32 CC1101 USB
user.description: Select the USB serial port where your ESP32 CC1101 transceiver is connected.

usb_confirm.title: ESP32 CC1101 Transceiver Discovered
usb_confirm.description: Do you want to configure the discovered ESP32 CC1101 USB transceiver connected at `{device}`?

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to the ESP32 on the selected port.

abort.already_configured: This serial port is already configured.

init.title: ESP32 CC1101 RF Studio
init.description: Choose an action to manage your RF devices or tune radio settings.

manage_devices.title: RF Devices & Remotes
manage_devices.description: Select an existing device to learn, configure or delete its buttons, or type a new device name directly.

device_menu.title: Configure Device: {device_name}
device_menu.description: Select an action for this device.

create_device.title: Create New RF Device
create_device.description: Enter a name for the device you want to control (e.g. Fan, Blinds, Garage). After creation, open the device to learn its remote buttons.

device_learn_button.title: Learn RF Button: {device_name}
device_learn_button.description: Enter the button name and repeats. Once submitted, hold down the button on your physical remote for 5 continuous seconds. Home Assistant will then prompt you to press it once to verify before saving.

device_configure_button.title: Configure Button: {device_name}
device_configure_button.description: Select an existing button and adjust its transmit repetitions.

device_delete_button.title: Delete Button: {device_name}
device_delete_button.description: Select the button to delete from this device.

radio_settings.title: CC1101 Radio Parameters
radio_settings.description: Configure operating frequency, modulation mode, and RF power levels in real time.

error.device_name_required: Please enter a name for the device.
error.button_name_required: Please enter a name for the button to learn.
error.no_buttons_found: No buttons found for this device.

abort.no_buttons_found: No buttons to delete for this device.
